method.source: Existing backend.app.satellogic_client.SatellogicClient; read-only catalog, STAC searches and order listing
method.raw_core_colossus2_resolved_by: 25 calendar-month slices, duplicate item IDs removed
method.coverage: Unweighted planar EPSG:4326 footprint-union intersection / query rectangle area, NOT valid ground pixels or a surveyed parcel
method.plausibility: Heuristic only: item gsd < 100 (missing treated as 0), footprint lon/lat spans < 2 degrees. This flags obvious corrupt raw footprints; passing does not establish processability, daytime quality, or site coverage.
method.visual_qc: Not performed. Asset URLs listed in raw STAC were checked for presence only; no imagery binaries rendered or downloaded.
method.map_source_note: Published Astro dataCenters records provided campus lngLat and bounds; query rectangles are not verified cadastral boundaries.
method.remaining_search_limit: Narrow Colossus 2 L0 query hit 1000. Broad regional L0 query was completed monthly; refine the regional raw results against a verified facility polygon before ordering.
